info.title: AxLink API
info.description: AxLink — provider-agnostic institutional settlement network. `/v1/*` is the institution contract (Architecture Blueprint names). Older paths under /api are aliases of the same services. Leg A: USDC and USDT on Solana in regulated custody; fiat legs are out of scope.

institutionKey.description: Institution API key: axlk_test_… (sandbox) or axlk_live_… (production). One environment per key.

opsKey.description: Operator key (OPS_API_KEY). Never issued to institutions.

depositAddress.description: One address receives every supported asset on the network (USDC and USDT share it on Solana).

status.description: PROCESSING until a Solana node reports the receipt finalized; COMPLETED only then; FAILED when expired or cancelled.

trackingId.description: Put this in the custody transfer's external id.

attention.description: Set when a receipt arrived but could not be credited, or on-chain proof failed.

lines.description: only the lines on accounts this institution owns

status.description: COMPLETED only when a Solana node reports the signature finalized

post.description: Deliveries carry `X-AxLink-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, t + "." + body)>` and `X-AxLink-Event-Id`. Events: deposit.received (custody confirmed, status PROCESSING), deposit.settled (on-chain finalized, COMPLETED), deposit.rejected (a receipt could not be credited; needs attention), deposit.expired. Retries on 5xx/408/429/timeouts at 1m, 5m, 30m, 2h, 12h; other 4xx are final; redirects are never followed. URLs must be public https hosts.

post.summary: Initiate an outbound settlement of USDC or USDT to an ACTIVE counterparty. Policy: available balance (journal minus transfers awaiting approval), per-transfer limit, counterparty and wallet ACTIVE. SANDBOX auto-approves under a limit; PRODUCTION always waits for an operator and requires OUTBOUND_SETTLEMENT_ENABLED.

200.description: Replay: the same request under the same Idempotency-Key (walletId, counterpartyId, asset, amount, reference all equal) returns the existing transfer

404.description: Wallet or counterparty not found in this environment

503.description: OUTBOUND_DISABLED (production outbound not enabled on this deployment)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per transfer request. A replay returns the same transfer (200); a different body under the same key is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH.
